WPMS No.1135 of 2026
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. M.S. Tyagi, learned Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. Sunil Chandra, learned counsel 
for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Sudhir Nailwal, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State.
3. Mr. Siddhartha Singh, learned counsel & Mr. 
Akshay Latwal, learned counsel for the private 
respondents.
4. By the instant petition, the petitioners are 
praying for the following reliefs:-
“(i) A writ or order in the nature of certiorari to quash/set￾aside the impugned judgment and order dated 03.02.2026 
(Annexure No.1, Page No. 16 to 27) passed in revision no. 
14/2025-26 (52/07 year 2024-25) "Shri Shambhu Suman 
Singh & Another Vs. Sharif Ahmad & others" by the 
learned Director of Consolidation, Uttarakhand, Dehradun 
and further may kindly declare the petitioners Bhumidhar 
with Transferable Right of Khasra no.06 area 0.2780 hect. 
situated at Village-Kichha, Tehsil-Kichha, District- Udham 
Singh Nagar.
(ii) Any other relief to the petitioners which this Hon'ble 
Court may deem fit and proper.
(iii) Award the cost of petition to the petitioners.
5. After arguing at length, Mr. Siddhartha 
Singh, Advocate, submitted that the matter may 
be posted on 02.05.2026.
6. List on 02.05.2026 as a fresh case.
7. In the meantime, the effect and operation 
of the dated 03.02.2026, passed by Director of 
Consolidation, Dehradun in Revision No.14/2025-
2026, “Shri Shambhu Suman Singh & Another Vs. 
Sharif Ahmad & others” shall remain stayed.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
 30.04.2026 Shiv/Pant
